query: UPDATE candidate SET review=?,name=?,aliases=?,emails=?,affiliations=?,homepages=?,research=?,papers=?,evidence=?,profile_url=coalesce(profile_url,?),list_page_id=coalesce(list_page_id,?),profile_page_id=coalesce(?,profile_page_id),profile_fields=?,match_names=?,match_schools=? WHERE id=? RETURNING profile_url
